text:
VGK arrives off a 6-2 loss at STL two days ago, the same score CBJ took against TOR four days back. The Golden Knights are 3-2-0 in their last five, and Parker Wotherspoon is out. Mitch Marner could return: he is day-to-day and off the out list. Columbus is 1-4-0 in its last five and has been outscored 20-10 in that stretch. There is a case they are better than their record: they hold 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and finishing has cost them 4.2 goals against those chances. Our model projects VGK 3.19 goals and CBJ 2.8.

At five on five there is little between them: VGK has 53% of the expected goals and CBJ 49%. The special teams look like the swing. VGK's power play creates 0.82 expected goals a game, while CBJ's penalty kill allows 0.89, and Columbus takes 4.2 penalties a game. In net, projected starters Carter Hart (VGK, -1.06 goals saved above expected, which measures saves beyond what the shots called for) and Jet Greaves (CBJ, -0.52) are both below par this season. Greaves was 15.02 above expected last year; Hart was 4.44 below in 18 games.

Marner is worth watching, with a 7-game point streak and a 67% chance at a point, and Jack Eichel is at 74%. Our under-the-radar pick is Adam Fantilli (CBJ), 54% for a point, above his season pace of 46%, as his line creates chances (3.96 expected goals per 60 with him on the ice).
